spec_match.rationale: Constructs real AudioContexts with renderSizeHint 'default' / 'hardware' / integer and reads back the actual renderQuantumSize attribute plus baseLatency/outputLatency — the exact IDL surface of the feature.

interactive.rationale: Three cards each create-and-inspect a real context; a numeric field drives the custom hint; contexts are closable; a summary table accumulates results.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise matches the page's verified behaviour.

edge_cases.rationale: Missing renderQuantumSize renders '(not exposed yet)' with an honest support note naming the anticipated milestone and the real enable path; constructor errors render in the result box.

references.rationale: Links the ChromeStatus entry and the renderSizeHint spec section.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite ran in the verification browser at 5 pass / 4 fail / 0 blocked — the 4 fails are the shipped-attribute assertions, the honest 'not yet shipped' answer on Chromium 141 (anticipated Chrome 153), exactly as their descriptions state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141): support note rendered the honest unsupported branch; default and hardware cards created contexts showing '(not exposed yet)' with real baseLatency 10.0 ms; console/network clean; screenshot v153-rq-explorer.png read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts rq-explorer-support-checked with the boolean and rq-explorer-context-created per created context.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons that override background also override color; small-text emerald readouts darkened via color-mix to meet AA.

accessibility.rationale: Support note is role=status aria-live=polite, custom size input has an aria-label, results are text in labelled boxes, and focus styling on the input is explicit.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/webaudio-configurable-render-quantum --no-server: desktop OK clean, mobile OK (sub-44px flags are inline links, primary buttons/sliders remain usable); both screenshots read and judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a build where the Chrome 153 flip has landed
openQuestions.detail: The verification browser (Chromium 141, no origin trial) does not expose renderQuantumSize, so every hint is honestly reported as ignored. Once a Chrome 153 stable (or a build launched with --enable-blink-features=WebAudioConfigurableRenderQuantum) is available, re-run the page and confirm the quantum readouts flip to real values and the four not-yet conformance assertions pass.

guidanceConsulted.evidence: Driver run: note text announced the unsupported branch

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let card grids collapse to one column on narrow viewports and keep wide code blocks scrolling inside their own container.
